387YE Winter Solstice Conclave sessions.d: Aleksandr Zoravich Novosad became Voice of the Horizons, Casimir Pakkanovic Mislova became Imperial Magus, Bloodcrow Arora became Archmage of Winter and Vellenka Vanyanova became Shadowed Torchbearer. The Rod and Shield and Golden Pyramid were sent to the Commonwealth, the Silver Chalice to Lantir, and the Celestial Arch, Sevenfold Path and Shuttered Lantern to Jarm. The Conclave asked the Senate for an Advisor on the Cold Sun and added Viridian's Wildfire Emberstrike to Imperial lore. It declined the Apex Hyperion's offers for the Silver Flame and accepted the Monarchs of the Vast's Gift of Light. The Sevenfold Path received 150 mana crystals for its Grand Lodge.

n.Druj: A Rod and Shield concord declaring the Druj to be collapsing and committing Conclave to averting the doom of the Dying Scorpion above all others failed.
n.Grendel: Mentioned in passing: a Golden Pyramid concord thanking the heralds active in Mareave contrasted the Empire with the Grendel, who it said had not seen Mareave's potential.
n.The League: Conclave condemned the idea of giving Imperial lore to the Silver Flame, the foreigners who control Cinion in the League territory of Spiral.
n.Thule: Mentioned in passing: Thule warlocks provided twenty mana to the Conclave font as part of their treaty obligations with the Empire.
n.Urizen: An endorsement to cast Regrow the Land's Heart on the Sarangrave in Urizen, using the power Llofir had offered, failed.

t.Mareave: Conclave thanked the heralds of the City of Gold and Lead and the City of Bar and Bond for their intervention during the Mareave campaign. The Golden Pyramid pledged to continue investing there.
t.Spiral: Conclave condemned disseminating Imperial lore to the Silver Flame, who hold Cinion within Spiral, and rejected the Apex Hyperion's offers made on that fledgling nation's behalf.

r.Spiral/Cinion: The Silver Flame's request for Imperial lore was formally condemned by Conclave. A neutral alignment with Sinokenon declined the offers made for the Tribunal of the Silver Flame, citing constitutional freedoms.

387YE Winter Solstice Imperial elections.d: National elections returned senators for Astolat, Hercynia, Kallavesa, Madruga, Miekarova, Necropolis, Ossium, Sarangrave, Skarsind, Temeschwar and Zenith. The Senate appointed ambassadors to Beoraidh, Jarm and the Iron Confederacy, several generals, and a range of other titles, including the Grimnir of Wittal Grove. The Synod judged cardinals, inquisitors and other religious posts; the Keeper of Oaths and the Speaker of the Highborn Assembly each received around four hundred votes. The Military Council appointed the Strategos of Navarr and of the Marches. Bourse auctions and votes filled many resource seats, and candidacies were declared for titles such as Imperial Magus and Archmage of Winter.

n.Dawn: Dawn's territory of Astolat chose Éamon Ashenmourn de Cordraco as its senator.
n.Druj: Mentioned in passing: the Druj are not named, though a senator, Bartimaeus, was elected for Sarangrave, a territory they held at the time.
n.Highguard: Highguard's territory of Necropolis returned Kish of the Flame Beneath the Earth as its senator.
n.Imperial Orcs: The Imperial Orcs' territory of Skarsind elected Bloodcrow Rasp as its senator.
n.Navarr: Navarr gained Rowyn of the Waystone Path as Senator for Hercynia. The Military Council appointed Mouse Ddawnswraig as Strategos of Navarr.
n.The Brass Coast: The Brass Coast's territory of Madruga elected Eulàlia i Phovas i Riqueza as its senator.
n.The League: The League's territory of Temeschwar returned Giuseppe Sanguineo von Temeschwar as its senator.
n.Urizen: Urizen's territory of Zenith chose Delara i Fijadoz i Guerra as its senator.
n.Varushka: Varushka elected two senators: Vasilmir Radovanovna Esskivic for Miekarova and Bronimir for Ossium.
n.Wintermark: Wintermark gained Rane Shardbearer as Senator for Kallavesa. Theowold Vakarsson was appointed Grimnir of Wittal Grove.

t.Astolat: Éamon Ashenmourn de Cordraco was elected Senator for Astolat.
t.Hercynia: Rowyn of the Waystone Path was elected Senator for Hercynia.
t.Kallavesa: Rane Shardbearer was elected Senator for Kallavesa. The Senate also appointed a new Grimnir of Wittal Grove within the territory.
t.Madruga: Eulàlia i Phovas i Riqueza was elected Senator for Madruga.
t.Miekarova: Vasilmir Radovanovna Esskivic was elected Senator for Miekarova.
t.Necropolis: Kish of the Flame Beneath the Earth was elected Senator for Necropolis.
t.Ossium: Bronimir was elected Senator for Ossium.
t.Sarangrave: Bartimaeus was elected Senator for Sarangrave, despite the territory being held by the Druj that season.
t.Skarsind: Bloodcrow Rasp was elected Senator for Skarsind.
t.Temeschwar: Giuseppe Sanguineo von Temeschwar was elected Senator for Temeschwar.
t.Zenith: Delara i Fijadoz i Guerra was elected Senator for Zenith.

r.Kallavesa/Wittal Grove: The Senate appointed Theowold Vakarsson as Grimnir of Wittal Grove.

387YE Winter Solstice Military Council o.d: Seven armies pushed into Sarangrave against the Druj and the Tower of the Skink. Dawn's Gryphon's Pride sought to help the Bloodwater Spears at Nesustak, and Varushka's Northern Eagle infiltrated the Salt Flats of Sanath. Six armies, three of them by forced march from Skallahn, moved on the Jotun in Bregasland. Five armies held Mitwold at Wayford. The Black Thorns, Wolves of War and Argent Sword launched overwhelming assaults on the Grendel in Redoubt. The Seventh Wave and Winter Sun pressed on in Mareave, and the Red Wind Corsairs landed in Feroz. Other armies rested or tended the fallen. The Towerjacks began a dam in Spiral, and the Pilgrim's Defiance marched into Therunin's East Ashes.

n.Dawn: Dawn's Eastern Sky made a Triumphant Charge on the Tower of the Skink and the Lions of Adelmar used Steel Roses in Sarangrave, while the Gryphon's Pride defended Sarangrave to help the Bloodwater Spears. The Golden Sun went west to defend Mitwold alongside the Marchers.
n.Druj: The Druj faced seven Imperial armies in Sarangrave, all aiming at the Tower of the Skink and the clearing of the swamp. The Northern Eagle infiltrated the Salt Flats of Sanath to burn their granaries and bridges.
n.Grendel: The Grendel faced overwhelming assaults by three armies in Redoubt and steady conquest by two more in Mareave. The Red Wind Corsairs landed in Feroz to challenge their hold on the Bay of Catazar.
n.Highguard: Highguard's Seventh Wave fought on in Mareave and the Valiant Pegasus tended the fallen in Mitwold under its departing general. The Granite Pillar rested in Astolat and sent advisors to the Commonwealth, and the Pilgrim's Defiance entered Therunin to push back the vallorn on Navarr's behalf.
n.Imperial Orcs: The Autumn Hammers force-marched to Bregasland using contracts with the City of Gold and Lead, and the Summer Storm pushed on against the Tower of the Skink. The Winter Sun continued its steady conquest of Mareave, including Fleisardh.
n.Jotun: The Jotun in Bregasland faced six Imperial armies, including three arriving by forced march. The Marchers aimed to drive them out of Gravenmarch and the Ottermire.
n.Navarr: Navarr's Black Thorns joined the overwhelming assault on the Grendel in Redoubt, and the Quiet Step was ordered to do whatever it took to clear the Druj from Sarangrave. Highguard marched into Therunin to help protect it for Navarr.
n.The Brass Coast: The Burning Falcon and Fire of the South force-marched to Bregasland in support of the Marches. The Red Wind Corsairs took to land in Oranseri to deny the Grendel dominion of the Bay of Catazar.
n.The League: The Wolves of War marched from Bastion to join the overwhelming assault on Redoubt. The Towerjacks dug in at Spiral to begin building a dam and reservoir in Apstrus.
n.The Marches: The Bounders and Strong Reeds fought to drive the Jotun out of Bregasland. The Drakes and Tusks held Wayford in Mitwold, and the Tusks' general offered ten thrones for the traitor Stephen of Sarcombe taken alive.
n.Urizen: The Argent Sword launched an overwhelming assault to drive the Grendel from Redoubt, and its supporters were to share the guerdon. The Citadel Guard joined the steady conquest of Sarangrave.
n.Varushka: The Boyar's Hasta gathered intelligence in Sarangrave on Druj vallorn-waking tactics, and the Golden Axe rested in a solid defence of Semmerholm. The Northern Eagle infiltrated the Salt Flats of Sanath.
n.Wintermark: The Narwhal's Spear sought the foe in Bregasland and its supporters were to share the guerdon. The Green Shield fought with honour in Mitwold, and the Bloodcloaks went home to Hahnmark to rest and tend the fallen.

t.Astolat: The Granite Pillar held a strategic defence of Astolat while it resupplied, and sent officers from there to advise the Commonwealth. The Golden Sun and Quiet Step marched out of Astolat.
t.Bastion: Mentioned in passing: the League's Wolves of War set out from Bastion to attack Redoubt.
t.Bay of Catazar: Mentioned in passing: the Red Wind Corsairs and the Wolves of War both named the Bay of Catazar in their orders as a prize to be contested with the Grendel.
t.Bregasland: Six armies converged on Bregasland to drive out the Jotun: the Bounders and Strong Reeds, the Narwhal's Spear, and the Autumn Hammers, Burning Falcon and Fire of the South by forced march. The Bloodcloaks and Drakes left the territory.
t.Feroz: The Red Wind Corsairs left the bay and took to land in Feroz at Oranseri to contest Grendel control.
t.Hahnmark: Wintermark's Bloodcloaks returned home to Hahnmark to rest, recover and tend the fallen.
t.Holberg: Mentioned in passing: Varushka's Northern Eagle set out from Holberg to infiltrate the Salt Flats of Sanath.
t.Mareave: Highguard's Seventh Wave and the Orcish Winter Sun continued their steady conquest of Mareave against the Grendel. The Towerjacks' planned dam was meant to make Mareave a finer home.
t.Mitwold: Five armies gathered to defend Mitwold, holding the line at Wayford: the Drakes, Golden Sun, Tusks, Green Shield and Valiant Pegasus.
t.Ossium: Mentioned in passing: the Boyar's Hasta's general raised a toast to Varushkan cousins in Ossium slaying peelers.
t.Redoubt: The Black Thorns, Wolves of War and Argent Sword launched overwhelming assaults to drive the Grendel out of Redoubt. The Pilgrim's Defiance left the territory for Therunin.
t.Salt Flats of Sanath: Varushka's Northern Eagle infiltrated the Salt Flats of Sanath to burn Druj granaries, demolish bridges and terrorise the slave masters.
t.Sarangrave: Seven armies fought in Sarangrave against the Druj and the Tower of the Skink, and the Boyar's Hasta gathered intelligence there. The Gryphon's Pride made for Nesustak to help the Bloodwater Spears raise watchtowers.
t.Semmerholm: Varushka's Golden Axe rested and celebrated while holding a solid defence of Semmerholm. Three armies marched out of the territory for Sarangrave.
t.Skallahn: Mentioned in passing: several armies, including the Autumn Hammers, Narwhal's Spear and Green Shield, left Skallahn for Bregasland and Mitwold.
t.Spiral: The League's Towerjacks dug in at Spiral to begin building a dam that would create a reservoir in Apstrus.
t.Therunin: Highguard's Pilgrim's Defiance marched Armoured by Faith into Therunin's East Ashes to drive the vallorn back to slumber, expecting heavy losses.
t.Upwold: Mentioned in passing: the Marches' Tusks marched from Upwold to defend Mitwold.

r.Bregasland/Gravenmarch: Gravenmarch was a target of the Marchers' Bounders, and the Autumn Hammers force-marched to reach it in support of the Marches.
r.Bregasland/Ottermire: The Bounders named the Ottermire among the lands they meant to retake from the Jotun by steady conquest.
r.Feroz/Oranseri: The Red Wind Corsairs came ashore in Oranseri to deny the Grendel victory.
r.Mareave/Fleisardh: The Winter Sun's orders named Fleisardh as a target of its steady conquest against the Grendel.
r.Spiral/Apstrus: The Towerjacks planned a dam to create a reservoir in Apstrus.
r.Therunin/East Ashes: The Pilgrim's Defiance marched into East Ashes to confront the vallorn. Its general expected three in ten soldiers to fall and the army to be forced back to Lustri.

387YE Winter Solstice Senate sessions.d: The treasury stood at 1519 thrones and 6 crowns. The Senate abrogated the Grendel embassy in Redoubt, ejecting its staff, and removed embassy upkeep and ministry access in exchange for gifts. It gave 90 thrones to Rhydian de Rondell of Dawn to stop Druj ritualists threatening to loose 25,000 vallornspawn on Therunin. It also created the Broker of Thorns and Stoat of the Sun, switched Thule's food supply from the Marches to Dawn, and renamed Mount Polus 'Kespoena's Reach'. Commissions included the Beacon of Sermersuaq, the rebuilt Great Library of Ankarien, a spy network in Tsirku and a wayhouse in Utterlund. Appraisals were sent to Volodmartz and Nesustak Forest.

n.Dawn: Rhydian de Rondell of Dawn received 90 thrones to defeat Druj ritualists in Therunin, Dawn replaced the Marches as Thule's food supplier, and Weirwater gained the Ozren Orzel tomb and the Story Garden, which offers potions to virtuous Dawnish citizens.
n.Druj: Senate funds were sent to defeat Druj ritualists in Therunin, whose working threatened to unleash 25,000 vallornspawn, and an appraisal was sought into the rebels of Nesustak Forest in Druj-held Sarangrave.
n.Grendel: The Grendel embassy in Redoubt was abrogated and its staff forcibly ejected, although the title of Ambassador to the Grendel was kept.
n.Highguard: Highborn citizens Melchior of Balthazar's Vineyard and Thaumiel of Steeplechase Toll became Ambassadors to Beoraidh and Jarm, and Highguard invited the Commonwealth's scholars to appraise closer military, trade and philosophical ties.
n.Imperial Orcs: The Sorrowful Tunnels were allocated as an Imperial Orc national title, and the Legion Rookery was turned into an edifice that halves the cost of extra mithril for the tunnels' miners.
n.Jotun: The Minister of Historical Research commissioned research into the Dance of Blood and its consequences for relations between the Navarr and the Jotun.
n.Navarr: Navarr gained the Broker of Thorns bourse seat in the Barrens through an accord with the Great Forest Orcs, and Arthur Bannerman of Navarr was appointed Captain of the Senate Guard. Research was also ordered into Dewyn High Thorn Path and the Dance of Blood.
n.The League: The League gave up the Tassatan Hills ilium mine, with 250 thrones repaid to Holberg's senator, and built the Circo del Topo in Temeschwar and a great lighthouse in Kallavesa, though the Rat Garden commission failed.
n.Thule: The nation feeding the Thule was switched from the Marches to Dawn, changing the limits on Imperial forces in Otkodov, and the election of an Ambassador to Otkodov was deferred to Spring 388YE.
n.Urizen: Urizeni senators expelled the Grendel embassy from Redoubt, rebuilt the Great Library of Ankarien, renamed Mount Polus 'Kespoena's Reach' and commissioned several works in Spiral and Zenith. Lightstone trade also brought extra coin to Morrow and Redoubt.
n.Varushka: Mine owners in Volodmartz and Miekarova each gained 36 extra rings a season through the Light Market, an appraisal was sent to restore prosperity to Volodmartz, and Vojsuli Cherenkov was ratified as General of the Golden Axe.
n.Wintermark: The final set of Wintermark's Beacons was commissioned in Sealtoq, Sermersuaq, drawing on a boon from Cathan Canae, completing the network.

t.Holberg: Holberg's senator received 250 thrones to repay the Tassatan Hills investors, a wayhouse was built in Utterlund, and a citizen donated 28 thrones towards the upkeep of Holberg's Walls.
t.Miekarova: Miekarova's mine owners will receive 36 extra rings each season from the Light Market, and its senator seconded the appraisal of Volodmartz's prosperity.
t.Morrow: Morrow's business owners will receive 36 extra rings each season from lightstone sold to Varushka, and the Three Watchers were put forward for re-examination in light of new fortification techniques.
t.Otkodov: Supplies for the Thule in Otkodov will now come from Dawn rather than the Marches, and an Ambassador to Otkodov is to be elected at the Spring Equinox 388YE.
t.Redoubt: The Grendel embassy in Redoubt was shut and its staff expelled, while Redoubt's business owners will receive 36 extra rings each season from the lightstone trade.
t.Sarangrave: Naomi of Virtue's Rest was sent to appraise solutions to the rebels of Nesustak Forest, with results due before the Spring Equinox 388YE.
t.Tsirku: The Imperial Spymaster commissioned an Imperial spy network in Tsirku.
t.Volodmartz: Graciana i Lopez i Guerra was sent to find ways to restore prosperity to the ruins left by the Cold Sun, and Volodmartz's mine owners will receive 36 extra rings each season.

r.Holberg/Utterlund: A self-funded wayhouse named The Splintered House was built in Utterlund.
r.Sarangrave/Nesustak Forest: The Senate sent Naomi of Virtue's Rest to appraise solutions to the rebels holding out in Nesustak Forest.

387YE Winter Solstice Synod judgements.d: The General Assembly proscribed as blasphemy the promotion of the false virtues of vengeance, understanding, hatred and freedom. It also proscribed the Excessionist and Yaelian heresies, and service to eternals that subsumes free will. It rejected bans on statues of eternals and on ceding land to them. Highest callings passed for Highguard (completing the Grand Inspiration), Wisdom (testing the Way) and Loyalty (anchoring the Way in Asavea). Those of the Way, Pride and the Freeborn failed. Mandates opened farm and business conversions for Marchers and Leaguers. The Varushkan Assembly revoked the Senator for Karsk. Rane Shardbearer and Veikko Bondforger joined the Chronicle of Heroism. Rewardings funded the Anvil Hospital and the fleet captains.

n.Dawn: The Dawnish Assembly urged settlement of the unceded Barrens except the Bleaks, forbade harassing the Karass, and endorsed Dawn taking over the Marches' obligation to feed the Thule. A Rewarding of weirwood for a Dawnish great work was not upheld.
n.Druj: The Ambition Assembly upheld a call to make defeated Druj septs Imperial vassal-states once the Buruk-Tepel fall, though not with the greater majority a highest calling requires. Highborn and orc assemblies urged the liberation and guidance of orcs enslaved by or escaping the Druj.
n.Grendel: The Silent Bell was sent to the Bay of Catazar to investigate Grendel spy networks, with a report due before the Summer Solstice 388YE. Urizen also named lingering Grendel malice in Spiral as a darkness to be cleared.
n.Highguard: The Highborn Assembly reaffirmed its claim on the Salt Flats of Sanath and a Necropolis–Bastion–Leen pilgrimage. It called for the liberation of enslaved Great Forest Orcs, sent aid to Livardz, and named completing the Grand Inspiration its highest calling (750-0). Berechiah's Basilica in Bastion received five wains of white granite.
n.Imperial Orcs: The orc assembly carved Rahvin words into the Ossuary's annals, urged the Summer Storm's preachers to guide escaped Druj, and sent Jim to learn of the Karass ancestors. Bloodcrow Knott was condemned for heresy, and the law on idolatry was proposed to be reworded to include orc citizens.
n.Jotun: Varushka reported the rebuilt Jotun meeting place as a place of hospitality. Wintermark pledged to show virtue through deeds at Gull Isle, and the Loyalty Assembly consecrated part of the new Gull Island feasting hall to Loyalty.
n.Navarr: Navarr backed rebuilding Thornsong House in Skarsind and urged Hercynia's folk to forswear rebuilding Hacynian. It sent its people to support Urizen's fight against the vallorn and revealed Idwynn Splitroot as the singer of "Painted". Rewardings supplied weirwood for the City of Dreams and mithril for the army mustering in Hercynia.
n.The League: The League Assembly called its bravos and mercenaries to clear the dark places of Spiral, mandated investigations of those betraying Sarvos, and opened conversions to businesses for a year. It also urged Temeschwar to claim Giselle's Tomb as its pride, while a penance was laid on Teodore Dusesna.
n.The Marches: The Marcher Assembly vowed to defend the Marcher Orcs against any proscription and sent the Hallowed Bells across its territories. It called for Bree's Stand to be built at Meade, asked Upwold to shelter Mitwold refugees, and urged Gullet coastal folk to gather coral husk samples. A mandate eased conversions to farms.
n.Thule: Varushka urged the peoples of the north to prepare together for war with the Thule. Dawn endorsed taking over the food owed to the Thule under the treaty so that the Marches could raise a fifth army.
n.Urizen: Urizen's assembly sent seers to locate the miasma pillars in the Sarangrave and called for darkness to be cleared from Spiral. It also affirmed the Spiral "rebels" as Urizen, welcomed Navarr's aid against the vallorn and backed the Gryphon's Pride's outreach to the Sarangrave septs.
n.Varushka: The Varushkan Assembly called for Livardz to rise from ruin, with Highguard answering, urged citizens to re-flower Karov and pressed for northern unity against the Thule. It also revoked the absent Senator for Karsk.
n.Wintermark: Wintermark welcomed Highguard's bell bearers and backed building a Hall of Names and rebuilding the Hall of the Soturi for its Kallavesi army. It also named Rane Shardbearer and Veikko Bondforger to the Chronicle of Heroism.

t.Karsk: The Varushkan Assembly revoked Sirka Parakgoosier Bashnya as Senator for Karsk for abandoning the post without a named proxy (174-0).
t.Reikos: Mentioned in passing: a small donation reached the Virtue Fund at the counting house of Reikos, and Joran of Reikos led a Highborn mandate.
t.Semmerholm: Mentioned in passing: a donation reached the Virtue Fund at Semmerholm's counting house, and the Senator for Semmerholm's Thule food motion was endorsed by the Dawnish Assembly.
t.Tassato: Mentioned in passing: two thrones were donated to the Virtue Fund at the counting house of Tassato, and several priests named di Tassato raised or featured in judgements.

387YE Winter Solstice event schedule.d: Nine nations held senatorial elections in their camps on Saturday afternoon, each by its own method, from the Brass Coast's auction to Wintermark's jars. Tally of the Votes elections for many national titles followed later that afternoon. The timetable listed Senate sessions on all three days with deadlines for motions, Synod judgement windows, Conclave sessions, Military Council sessions and battles off Anvil on Saturday and Sunday mornings. Notable bookings included a Senate Chamber discussion on peace with the Druj, a Thule delegation, the Auction of the Seats for Imperial Bourse positions, the Callidus auction, a parley with the Whisper Gallery and the Trial of Severus of the Temple of the Blinding Sun.

n.Dawn: Dawn elected the senator for Astolat at 2:30pm, immediately after the tourney, and Dawnish fleet captains met in the Military Council Tent on Saturday.
n.Druj: Mentioned in passing: a discussion on peace with the Druj was booked in the Senate Chamber on Saturday at 1pm, and the Druj-held Sarangrave appeared in Urizen's senatorial election.
n.Highguard: Highguard began its inquisition of candidates for the Necropolis senator at 2pm and elected the Vigilant Swan by Tally of the Votes at the Chapel at 3:30pm.
n.Imperial Orcs: The orcs chose Skarsind's senator from 2:15pm, as candidates presented items of worth, then elected four titles, including the Shepherd of the Southern Herd, at the Fire Pit at 4pm.
n.Navarr: Navarr elected the Hercynia senator immediately after the standing at 1:15pm and the Broker of the Invisible Cord at the Standing Circle at 3:30pm.
n.The Brass Coast: The Brass Coast opened its auction for the Madruga senatorship at 1pm and elected the Vizier of the Incarnadine Satchel and the Marracossa Sendito at the Waypoint at 5pm.
n.The League: The League chose Temeschwar's senator at 3:30pm by presenting collected bonds, elected the Master of Rings and the Chair of the Wolf in the Plaza at 5pm, and hosted the Sarvos Chamber of Commerce on Saturday.
n.Thule: Mentioned in passing: a Thule delegation was booked in the Senate Chamber on Saturday at 6pm.
n.Urizen: Urizen held a demos from 1pm to 1:30pm to elect senators for Zenith and Sarangrave, and elected titles including the Gloaming Merchant and the Arch of the Sky near the Net of Heaven at 5:30pm.
n.Varushka: Varushka began questioning candidates for the Miekarova and Ossium senatorships at 1:45pm and elected seven titles, including the Harbourmaster of the Semmerlak, at the Central Hearth at 4pm.
n.Wintermark: Wintermark elected the Kallavesa senator from 2pm, with jars placed down for fifteen minutes.

t.Astolat: Astolat's senator was elected in the Dawnish camp at 2:30pm, immediately after the tourney.
t.Hercynia: Hercynia's senator was chosen by the Navarr at 1:15pm, immediately after the standing.
t.Kallavesa: Kallavesa's senatorship was decided by Wintermark's jars, set down for fifteen minutes from 2pm.
t.Madruga: Madruga's Senate seat was put to the Brass Coast's auction, beginning at 1pm.
t.Miekarova: Miekarova's senator was elected in the Varushkan camp, with questioning of candidates beginning at 1:45pm.
t.Necropolis: Necropolis's senator was chosen by Highguard, with the inquisition of candidates beginning at 2pm.
t.Ossium: Ossium's senator was elected alongside Miekarova's in Varushka, with questioning beginning at 1:45pm.
t.Sarangrave: Although held by the Druj, Sarangrave's senatorial title was among those elected by the Urizen demos at 1pm; the next regular election for it falls at the Spring Equinox 388YE.
t.Sarvos: Mentioned in passing: a Sarvos Chamber of Commerce meeting was held in the League Plaza on Saturday at 4pm.
t.Skarsind: Skarsind's senator was chosen by the Imperial Orcs from 2:15pm, as candidates presented items of worth.
t.Temeschwar: Temeschwar's senator was elected by the League at 3:30pm through the presentation of collected bonds.
t.Zenith: Zenith's senator was elected by the Urizen demos, running from 1pm to 1:30pm.

387YE Winter Solstice interlude.d: The Imperial Guerdon was set at 500 Thrones and shared only among units supporting the Drakes and Strong Reeds in Bregasland, the Golden Axe and Summer Storm in Sarangrave, and the Seventh Wave and Winter Sun in Mareave. Urizen units could raid the Disciples of Sulemaine. Fleets could map the coast beyond the Salt Flats, raid Asavean shipping, hunt kraken in Free Landing or trade at the Jakhalsmarkt. Congregations could encourage pilgrimage to Capodomus or Hacynian. Rivers of Life protected Redoubt and Sarangrave, and fortification rituals were laid on many regions. The Children of Wrecks' storms struck Feroz, Madruga and Sarvos, while Night and Autumn magic flooded Madruga and the Barrens.

n.Dawn: The Barrens was flooded with Autumn magic, bringing easier travel, fruitful negotiations and strokes of luck for Dawnish citizens, while Phoenix Rising raised a Frozen Citadel over Hope's Rest.
n.Druj: Imperial fleets were offered a voyage to map the coastline beyond the Salt Flats of Sanath while deliberately avoiding the Druj. Meanwhile, Guerdon-backed armies fought in Sarangrave under Rivers of Life.
n.Grendel: Grendel-held Feroz was battered by Spring storms unleashed by the Children of Wrecks, and Imperial fortification rituals were laid across contested regions of Mareave and Redoubt.
n.Highguard: Mentioned in passing: Highguard appears only in the monstering numbers table, at 90%.
n.Imperial Orcs: Mentioned in passing: the Imperial Orcs appear only in the monstering numbers table, at 88%, though the Skarsind wayhouse was built on their lands.
n.Jotun: Mentioned in passing: Jotun-held Bregasland is named as the place where the Drakes and Strong Reeds armies received Guerdon support.
n.Navarr: With the Ashen Tears wayhouse complete in Skogei Glens, Navarr could take a new Skarsind resource for free, and such resources count as Hercynia for elections. The Voice of the Quiet Forest also forged a Wooden Fastness over Eastring.
n.The Brass Coast: Madruga suffered storms and a flood of Night magic, and Frozen Citadel was cast on Braydon's Jasse. Freeborn fleets gained a bonus rank to hunt juvenile kraken in Free Landing.
n.The League: Wreckers used the Circle of Savagery in Sarvos to unleash torrential storms there, cutting the output of the territory's farms and businesses by 72 rings.
n.The Marches: Marcher fleets gained a one-rank bonus when trading at Caitun, and Brother Luke of the Marches funded the Remember the Fallen ritual for Imperial Lore.
n.Urizen: Urizen units were called to raid the Disciples of Sulemaine under a national mandate. The Convocation of the Mistral cast Rivers of Life on Redoubt and Sarangrave, and new fortifications rose in Lustri, Siluri and Tomari.
n.Varushka: Mentioned in passing: Varushka appears in the monstering numbers table at 130%.
n.Wintermark: The Sussivari Frost Coven cast Dripping Echoes of the Fen on West Marsh, and Wintermark fleets gained a one-rank bonus when trading at Caitun.

t.Bregasland: Military units supporting the Drakes and Strong Reeds in Bregasland were among the few to receive shares of the 500-Throne Guerdon.
t.Feroz: The Children of Wrecks unleashed thunderstorms and torrential rain over Feroz, and farms and businesses there produced 72 rings less.
t.Hercynia: Mentioned in passing: Navarr with a resource in Skarsind count as being in Hercynia for senatorial and similar elections.
t.Kahraman: The Voices of the Unbound Storm raised a Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae over Braydon's Jasse.
t.Kallavesa: The Sussivari Frost Coven cast Dripping Echoes of the Fen on West Marsh.
t.Madruga: Madruga was flooded with Night magic that brought dreams of shifting dark forests, and was lashed by storms that cut farm and business output by 72 rings. Fleets were also invited to hunt kraken in Free Landing.
t.Mareave: Units supporting the Seventh Wave and Winter Sun in Mareave received Guerdon shares. The Basalt Citadel and several Frozen Citadels were cast across Eoradal, Icarion and Nadir.
t.Redoubt: Rivers of Life reduced army casualties and filled Redoubt's waters with life-giving Spring power, while the Ashen Flame raised Frozen Citadels over Siluri and Tomari.
t.Salt Flats of Sanath: Mentioned in passing: fleets were offered a voyage to map the coastline beyond the Salt Flats while avoiding the Druj.
t.Sarangrave: Rivers of Life was woven over Sarangrave, reducing army losses. Units supporting the Golden Axe and Summer Storm there received Guerdon shares.
t.Sarvos: Wreckers used the Circle of Savagery to unleash storms on Sarvos, cutting the territory's farm and business output by 72 rings.
t.Skarsind: The Ashen Tears wayhouse was completed in Skogei Glens, letting Navarr take resources in Skarsind for free this season.
t.The Barrens: The Barrens was flooded with Autumn magic that eased travel and dealings, and Phoenix Rising cast a Frozen Citadel over Hope's Rest.
t.Therunin: The Voice of the Quiet Forest cast Forge the Wooden Fastness on Eastring.
t.Zenith: The Goatsbridge Coven cast Forge the Wooden Fastness on Lustri.

r.Kallavesa/West Marsh: West Marsh received Dripping Echoes of the Fen from the Sussivari Frost Coven.
r.Madruga/Free Landing: Fleets were offered the chance to hunt juvenile kraken driven into the open in Free Landing, with Johann Van Basten promising to buy Ambrellic at two crowns a portion.
r.Mareave/Eoradal: Eoradal received both the Basalt Citadel from the Heralds of the Reaper and a Frozen Citadel from the Voices of the Unbound Storm.
r.Mareave/Icarion: The Voices of the Unbound Storm cast a Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae on Icarion.

r.Redoubt/Tomari: The Ashen Flame cast a Frozen Citadel of Cathan Canae on Tomari.

387YE Winter Solstice winds of fortune.d: Vesna celebrated victories over the Druj and urged heroes against the Jotun, especially in Bregasland. The Imperial regio appears to have run dry or been blocked. Several appraisals reported their findings, on a bridge to the Brass Coast islands, Spiral, the ministries and Tassato's printers. The Marcher, Navarr and Imperial Orc highest callings bore fruit. The Walls of Holberg were completed. The Freeborn Assembly faces a perilous choice over a mandate rejecting Anarchy. Kraken hunters brought back valuable ambrellic. Conjunction results included Whisperwood being claimed, Jotun leaders killed in Bregasland and Kahraman, and the Tower of Light and Shadow destroyed in Naris.

n.Dawn: The Barrens is quieter than in living memory, with good and bad news alike. The civil service confirmed that the Druj remnants there are only a skirmish-level threat, and that Calvary's End was an outlier whose people have been rehomed across Dawn.
n.Druj: Vesna celebrated Imperial victories over the Druj, and the Empire claimed Whisperwood after destroying its miasma pillars. The Druj were also among the orc nations engaging in diplomacy, and only small remnant bands remain in former incursion territories.
n.Grendel: The Grendel kept the Pinnacle and claimed Tassatan gravegoods after the Naris conjunction went untaken. The Empire's spies converged on a suspected Grendel espionage ring in Sarvos, and the Grendel were among the orcs pursuing diplomacy.
n.Highguard: A grand lodge for the Sevenfold Path was proposed for Necropolis. The Highborn Assembly urged support for their cousins in Sarvos against espionage, and the Custodian of the Imperial War Memorial will now be elected yearly from Spring 388YE.
n.Imperial Orcs: The Imperial Orcs' highest calling for an Assembly of the Ancestors has stirred many to revive links with their ancestors, aided by the Illarawm. Mareave is reported to be thriving, and husks were defeated in Skarsind.
n.Jotun: Vesna called on Imperial heroes to turn against the Jotun, especially in Bregasland. Eisa Winterborn and Ghodi Melker were killed at Leakey Moss, Jarl Gorm Gillasbairn was slain in Kahraman, and the Jotun were defeated at Schogsfestward. They were also among the orcs pursuing diplomacy.
n.Navarr: The Navarr declared support for the Vallornguard their highest calling, and Llofir offered boons to the Navarr after the Conclave's neutrality. Navarri performed rites at the Singing Circle and the Three Stones, while the vallorn advance in Therunin.
n.The Brass Coast: The nation faces an existential choice over whether to enact a mandate rejecting Anarchy, which divinations say would set the whole Coast on fire. An appraisal explored reconnecting the islands to the mainland, and the Broken Shore Bounty can now be re-established.
n.The League: The Walls of Holberg were completed, and an appraisal proposed ways to boost Spiral's prosperity. Temeschwar faces rumours of an ancient creature beneath its sewers, and the League Assembly urged vigilance against espionage in Sarvos.
n.The Marches: Three eternal kings offered boons to Marcher smiths, landskeepers and mummers, and the highest calling turned attention to the Imperial Breadbasket. A pamphlet sparked wider interest in Marcher maritime traditions.
n.Thule: The latest treaty with Otkodov has been ratified as law, and Thule delegations are expected at Anvil for its formal signing. The peace, secured largely by ceding northern Imperial lands, is not universally popular.
n.Urizen: Sarangrave was assigned to Urizen and faces many deadly challenges. The Disciples of Sulemaine have been unravelled, the Tower of Light and Shadow in Redoubt was destroyed, and an appraisal sought cooperation with the League in Spiral.
n.Varushka: Mentioned in passing: Varushkan military units and the General of the Boyar's Hasta were tagged in the Otkodov diplomacy wind, and Varushkans were among the visitors expected at Anvil.
n.Wintermark: The mystics of Ishal proposed reconvening the Witan to guide the creation of a new Kallavesi army. Wintermark won the grand challenge at Axmure, Thurwolf was executed, and the Voices of Tanikipari and the Wastes were killed in Sermersuaq.

t.Bay of Catazar: The Children of Wrecks had seeded the bay with kraken larvae, and the civil service suggested that an appraisal could explore securing a lasting supply of valuable ambrellic from them.
t.Bregasland: Vesna singled out Bregasland as the focus against the Jotun, and Imperial heroes killed two Jotun leaders at Leakey Moss. Support for the Greywaters there is noted as ongoing.
t.Brocéliande: Navarri visited the Singing Circle in Vale's Lament and performed an arcane projection there. Small Druj remnant bands are also noted in the territory.
t.Feroz: The Iron Confederacy drove the Children of Wrecks from the Cazar Straits. The Celesti Lighthouse, repaired at the urging of Feroz's senator, now enables the Broken Shore Bounty to be restored.
t.Hahnmark: Imperial heroes brought Thurwolf back from Northspires to be executed. Remnants of Cold Sun's forces are noted as a lingering skirmish threat in Hahnmark.
t.Holberg: The excavation of Holberg's embankment was completed after a year and 500 thrones, cementing its walls as a wonder of the known world.
t.Kahraman: Jarl Gorm Gillasbairn was killed at the Golden Copse in Gambit.
t.Kallavesa: The mystics of Ishal have been working towards a new Kallavesi army to take up the blade laid down by the Fist of the Mountains, and propose involving the Witan to do more.
t.Liathaven: Imperial heroes defeated the Jotun at Schogsfestward and rescued most of the defenders of Schogsfestnir.
t.Madruga: Madruga gave a fairly clear response to the judgement against Anarchy. Wreckers were stopped at Calvos Sound, and kraken hunters off Free Landing gathered a haul of ambrellic.
t.Mareave: Mareave is thriving: the grand aqueduct and the Golden Pyramid's grand lodge are complete. Skoura seeks closer ties, and Beoraidh adjusts to Imperial rule.
t.Mitwold: The Reconquest Cup exhibition was played at Meade March, where the corpse of Alf Alwen was later identified. The maritime traditions pamphlet was penned in Meade.
t.Morrow: Mentioned in passing: named as one of the Urizen heights to which Sarangrave must now be raised.
t.Mournwold: Mentioned in passing: Mournwold and the Old Pigs won the Reconquest Cup 5-4, and the late Quay Stone of the Mournwold was credited with inspiring the maritime pamphlet.
t.Necropolis: An ambitious grand lodge for the Sevenfold Path has been proposed here, and wreckers were stopped from completing a ritual at Longbeach.
t.Ossium: Mentioned in passing: listed among territories with small remnant Druj groups since recent incursions.
t.Otkodov: The latest treaty between the Empire and Otkodov has been ratified, with delegations to come to Anvil for a formal signing.
t.Redoubt: The shroud over the Tower of Light and Shadow in Naris was pierced and the tower destroyed, leaving Winter spirits uncontrolled and the Pinnacle still in Grendel hands.
t.Sarangrave: Newly assigned to Urizen, Sarangrave faces many deadly challenges. Whisperwood was claimed and wounded were treated in the Turan Flats, but three efforts in Kroll ended in retreat.
t.Sarvos: Sarvos is the focus of efforts to root out a suspected espionage ring, and wreckers unleashed a Thunderous Deluge at Riposi.
t.Sea of Snow: Mentioned in passing: the Sea of Snow is not named on this page.
t.Semmerholm: Wintermark were victorious in the grand challenge at the Grove of the Thousand in Axmure.
t.Sermersuaq: After years of invasion and the Cult of the Falconer, Sermersuaq has a chance to recover. Heroes killed the Voices of Tanikipari and the Wastes, destroyed three pillars and saved wounded merchants in Stark.
t.Skarsind: Rampaging husks were defeated at the Broken Forest in Solvhill.
t.Spiral: An appraisal proposed ways to blend League innovation and Urizen wisdom here. The Silver Flame claim Spiral's heritage, and a Grendel espionage ring remains, though damaged.
t.Tassato: The Printers' Guild of Tassato received appraisal findings on expanding its reach. Tassatan gravegoods were claimed by the Grendel in Naris, and brigands roam Tassato's wilds.
t.Temeschwar: The rat plague has calmed under the Rat Kings' contract, but rumours persist of an ancient creature dating from Varushkan times living below the city's sewers.
t.The Barrens: The Barrens is unusually quiet, with good and bad news alike. The civil service clarified that Druj remnants pose only a skirmish threat, and that Calvary's End has been resolved and its people rehomed.
t.Therunin: Ettercap nests in Sweetglades had mixed results, and the vallorn continued to advance after the Thorngroves conjunction went untaken. The Dance of Navarr and Thorn was performed at the Three Stones.
t.Tsirku: Mentioned in passing: those interested in Tsirku were tagged in the Sermersuaq wind of fortune.
t.Zenith: Mentioned in passing: cited as a Urizen height for Sarangrave to aspire to, and as home to lingering Druj partisans.

r.Bregasland/Grey Fens: At Leakey Moss, under Field Marshal Amberlain P. Black, Eisa Winterborn and Ghodi Melker were killed and their orders claimed, though Seeker Alma survived.
r.Brocéliande/Vale's Lament: The Singing Circle was visited, and several Navarri performed an arcane projection there.
r.Feroz/Cazar Straits: The Iron Confederacy drove the Children of Wrecks out of the Straits, where the Broken Shore Bounty offices were originally located.
r.Feroz/Morajasse: Mentioned in passing: the Protectorate of Morajasse was listed among the nations engaged in orc diplomacy this season.
r.Hahnmark/Northspires: Thurwolf was taken in the Greyhearth Woods, brought back through the Sentinel Gate and executed by magistrates.
r.Kahraman/Gambit: Jarl Gorm Gillasbairn was killed at the Golden Copse.
r.Liathaven/Liaven's Glen: The Jotun were defeated at Schogsfestward and most of the defenders of Schogsfestnir were rescued.
r.Madruga/Calvos Sound: Wreckers were stopped from completing their ritual at Mawrig's Point, though the Imperials then retreated.
r.Madruga/Free Landing: Fleets hunted juvenile kraken in the waters around Free Landing, battling Wreckers and returning with a valuable haul of ambrellic.
r.Mareave/Beoraidh: The independent city-state still prizes its neutrality but is facing the realities of life under Imperial rule. Beoraidh was also among the orc nations engaging in diplomacy.
r.Mareave/Eoradal: Mentioned in passing: the ruins of Eoradal are noted as protected, along with the grand aqueduct, by Ruicraic's Redoubt.
r.Mitwold/Meade March: Mournwold and the Old Pigs won the Reconquest Cup at the New Old Sports Field, and the corpse of Alf Alwen was later identified. The maritime pamphlet was penned in Meade.
r.Mitwold/Oddmire: Mentioned in passing: Oddmire is not named; Mitwold is noted only for its extensive coast and its sailors.
r.Necropolis/Longbeach: Wreckers were stopped from completing their ritual at Abigal's Orchard.
r.Redoubt/Naris: The conjunction was not taken: the Tower of Light and Shadow was destroyed, Winter spirits were left uncontrolled, and the fate of Muirgheal Cuindlis is unknown.
r.Sarangrave/Kroll: Three Imperial efforts ended in retreat: only half the tortured souls were exorcised, and neither Flavia of the Guiding Lights nor Dmitriy Innokentievich was ended.
r.Sarangrave/Turan Flats: Wounded were successfully treated at both Lamorak's Rest and Ormgore's Spinney.
r.Sarangrave/Whisperwood: Under Field Marshal Eisa Ironlungs, the miasma pillars were destroyed and Whisperwood was claimed from the Druj.
r.Sarvos/Riposi: Wreckers at the Circle of Savagery were not stopped, and a Thunderous Deluge was unleashed on Sarvos.
r.Semmerholm/Axmure: Wintermark beat Dawn in the grand challenge at the Grove of the Thousand.
r.Sermersuaq/Stark: Wounded merchants were saved at the Iron Crossroads.
r.Sermersuaq/Suaq Fount: The pillar at Icelveld was destroyed, but the Voice of the Fount survived.
r.Sermersuaq/Suaq Wastes: The Voice of the Wastes was killed and its pillar destroyed at Wulfhere's Meadow.
r.Sermersuaq/Tanikipari: The Voice of Tanikipari was killed and its pillar destroyed on the Plains of Cyneswith.
r.The Barrens/The Bleaks: Mentioned in passing: monsters in the Bleaks are noted as part of the noise in an otherwise quieter Barrens.
r.Therunin/Greenheart: The Three Stones were visited and the Dance of Navarr and Thorn performed there.
r.Therunin/Sweetglades: Of three ettercap nests, one was investigated and a treatment identified, one was poisoned, and at the third the Imperials were repulsed.

387YE Winter Solstice winds of war.d: The Druj still held Therunin, and their malice had woken the vallorn of Tharunind, which was swelling beyond the Sweetglades and Greenheart. The Imperial armies had withdrawn but the fighting was not over. Four battle opportunities were identified: against Wayford rebels in Mitwold, the Druj in Sarangrave, the Jotun in Skallahn and the Grendel in Mareave. The generals would pick two at the Military Council muster. Conjunctions pitted Imperial heroes against wreckers, Grendel, Druj, Jotun, coral husks and the Disciples of Sulemaine. One sent help to Varushkan wagon raiders stranded in Ayereed. A list of military considerations set out national order rules, border patrol mandates and territorial bonuses.

n.Dawn: Dawn brought a force weight of 58, its armies still cannot take Cautious Advance or Give Ground, and patrols under Ser Tunic's mandate mean the Druj need 25 victory points for a beachhead in the Barrens. The Envoy to the Karass was offered a meeting with Anka Karass in the Bleaks.
n.Druj: The Druj still occupied Therunin, where their malice had woken the vallorn. They were the foe in the Sarangrave battle opportunity and in conjunctions at Peakedge Song, Eastring and Whisperwood.
n.Grendel: The Grendel were the opposition in the Mareave battle opportunity to deny the Haulers of the Tide. They were also the target of conjunctions in Spiral, Redoubt, Necropolis and Ayereed, where they were pursuing Varushkan wagon raiders.
n.Highguard: Highguard brought a force weight of 26, and its armies may take Protect the Innocent and gain bonuses attacking Zenith from Morrow. Conjunctions called its people to Fishguard to fight the Grendel and to Casfall to rescue mendicant Garev.
n.Imperial Orcs: Mentioned in passing: the Imperial Orcs are listed with a force weight of 6 for the battle opportunities.
n.Jotun: The Jotun were the opposition in the Skallahn battle opportunity to intercept Ghodi Uksahkka, and were targeted by conjunctions to kill Eluf Asbjørnsson in Greenwall and a warband in Ottermire. Wintermark armies gain special bonuses when fighting them.
n.Navarr: Navarr brought a force weight of 61 while Therunin, held by the Navarr for centuries, remained under Druj occupation with the vallorn spreading. Several conjunctions there and in Hercynia fell to Navarri offices, including talks on relocating the Glimmerwater steading.
n.The Brass Coast: The Brass Coast brought a force weight of 17. Conjunctions in Madruga called for defeating wreckers at the Crucible and protecting the House of Guerra in Torres.
n.The League: The League brought a force weight of 20. Conjunctions in Sarvos targeted wreckers and threats to the Library Scriptorium, and those in Spiral targeted the Grendel and the Disciples of Sulemaine.
n.The Marches: Rebel Marchers, the Wayford Traitors, were the foe in the Mitwold battle opportunity, and the Marches brought a force weight of 27. Marcher armies cannot Give Ground but gain strength in their home territories, where any army may Billet, and conjunctions sought to protect Benson's Orchard and rescue shipwrecked Marchers in Skallahn.
n.Urizen: Urizen brought a force weight of 11, and its armies gain bonuses attacking Zenith from Morrow. Patrols under Herminius's mandate mean the Druj need 25 victory points for a beachhead in Morrow and Zenith, while conjunctions in Redoubt, Morrow and Sarangrave fell to Urizeni offices.
n.Varushka: Varushka brought a force weight of 15, Ossium's borders are patrolled under Velko Perunovich Razorasza's mandate, and its armies may take Hospitality of the Boyars there. Varushkan wagon raiders stranded in Ayereed appealed for help through Mother Varushka.
n.Wintermark: Wintermark brought the largest force weight at 72, can take Fight with Honour, and gains special bonuses against the Jotun. Conjunctions called its people to Sermersuaq, Kallavesa and Skallahn.

t.Ayereed: Varushkan wagon raiders searching for the isle of Dunreagh were run aground and pursued by Grendel. A conjunction tasked the Bargainer of the Iron Tower, Vladimir Sasha Volkov, with defeating the guards so they could escape.
t.Bay of Catazar: Mentioned in passing: the Bay of Catazar is listed as a conflict with its own Wind, Red skies.
t.Bregasland: Conjunctions sought to kill a Jotun warband in Ottermire and stop coral husks in the North Fens. Imperial armies may Billet here and the Strong Reeds gain 1000 strength fighting here.
t.Casinea: A conjunction at Casca's Doom in Casfall offered a chance to heal and rescue mendicant Garev.
t.Hercynia: A conjunction at the Starwood Roots Steading in Northpines asked the Archmage of Winter to investigate strange rumours.
t.Kallavesa: A conjunction at Ingrid's Rock in West Marsh sought to stop the coral husks.
t.Madruga: Conjunctions called for defeating wreckers at Draws Sward in the Crucible and protecting the House of Guerra on the Corsair's Road in Torres.
t.Mareave: Mareave offered a battle opportunity to deny the Haulers of the Tide at Capstone Veld, and had its own Wind, Scarlet sands. Varushkan wagon raiders had been exploring its coasts.
t.Mitwold: Mitwold offered a battle opportunity against the rebel Wayford Traitors at Two Barrel Field. Imperial armies may Billet here and the Drakes gain 1000 strength fighting here.
t.Morrow: Conjunctions targeted wreckers in Peregro and the Disciples of Sulemaine in Altis, and citizen patrols mean the Druj need 25 victory points for a beachhead. Highborn and Urizeni armies gain bonuses attacking Zenith from here and defending here.
t.Mournwold: A conjunction at the Hare Stone in Alderly responded to the call of Warrenwise. Imperial armies may Billet here and the Tusks gain 1000 strength fighting here.
t.Necropolis: A conjunction at Myfanwy's Rest in Fishguard called on the Abbess of Reconciliation to defeat the Grendel.
t.Ossium: Citizen patrols under Velko Perunovich Razorasza's mandate mean the Druj need 25 victory points for a beachhead here. Varushkan armies may take Hospitality of the Boyars here.
t.Redoubt: Redoubt had its own Wind, Blood-red blooms. Conjunctions targeted the Grendel in Siluri and Tomari and the Disciples of Sulemaine in Limus.
t.Sarangrave: Sarangrave had its own Wind, Fire and the flood, and offered a battle opportunity to protect the Shield at Camp Askoun Orama. A conjunction in Whisperwood fell to the Strategos of Urizen.
t.Sarvos: Conjunctions targeted wreckers in Uccelini and sought to protect the Library Scriptorium in Foracci.
t.Sermersuaq: Conjunctions in the Suaq Wastes sought to kill the Ceaseless Hunter and the Feasting Lord, and cadets were invited to clear coral husks in Stark.
t.Skallahn: Skallahn had its own Wind, Rubies in the snow, and offered a battle opportunity to intercept Ghodi Uksahkka. Conjunctions targeted Eluf Asbjørnsson, a construct heading for Kierheim and shipwrecked Marchers in need of rescue.
t.Spiral: Conjunctions in Apulus called for defeating the Grendel at Aphelion Cape and intercepting the Disciples of Sulemaine on Hadrian's Path.
t.The Barrens: Citizen patrols under Ser Tunic's mandate mean the Druj need 25 victory points for a beachhead here. A conjunction in the Bleaks offered talks with Anka Karass on Imperial law.
t.Therunin: The Druj still held Therunin and the vallorn was swelling across its marshes and forests after the Imperial armies withdrew. Several conjunctions in Eastring and Peakedge Song offered ways to fight back.
t.Upwold: A conjunction at Benson's Bawn in Tower March sought to protect Benson's Orchard. Imperial armies may Billet here and the Bounders gain 1000 strength fighting here.
t.Zenith: Citizen patrols mean the Druj need 25 victory points for a beachhead here. Highborn and Urizeni armies attacking into Zenith from Morrow gain bonuses.

A wild night and a new road.d: Imperial access to the Jakhalsmarkt in Betovering was extended, despite the risk of angering the Commonwealth over Jarmish star jewels. The deBruin offered 1,500 effective strength for an attack on Free Landing for 12 Thrones, provided the force receives the Imperial guerdon. Burgemeester Vandersaar invited the League, Highguard and the Brass Coast to celebrate five years of the Alivetti enclave, with assemblies able to encourage or discourage attendance. The Senate might fund magistrates or build the Walls of Liberty to stop smuggling, which would anger the Sarcophan. An administrative motion would settle who may disseminate herbals. The Cathedral of the Navigators kept losing prestige.

n.Grendel: Mentioned in passing: Grendel is not named, but the page discusses Sarcophan entrepreneurs developing a presence in the city-state of Beoraidh in western Mareave.
n.Highguard: Highborn businesses and mines kept earning an extra 18 rings a season from Sarcophan demand for Highborn funerary sculpture, while the Cathedral of the Navigators lost further ministry production and prestige. Highborn citizens were also invited to the Alivetti celebrations, and their assembly could encourage or discourage attendance.
n.Jotun: Mentioned in passing: the Jotun capture of Meade has put the Master of the Root and Stem trade on hold, which the Delves regard as a minor aberration.
n.The Brass Coast: Ambassador Dino i Riqueza handled Sarcophan relations, and Madruga's senator could hire deBruin mercenaries to help retake Free Landing. Freeborn businesses were invited to the Alivetti festivities, which offered trade diversification, and the Freeborn assembly could back or discourage the event.
n.The League: The Sarcophan enclave in Sarvos marked five prosperous years, and League citizens were invited to its festival. The Senate might fund Sarvosan magistrates or build the Walls of Liberty with a new League title, the Alivetti Gatekeeper. The League assembly had already restricted the Community of Silence to the enclave.
n.Wintermark: Mentioned in passing: Wintermark captains, especially Bron Mordssen, drew praise for their dealings at the Jakhalsmarkt in Betovering.

t.Bay of Catazar: Mentioned in passing: an earlier wind of fortune on growing Sarcophan influence in the Bay of Catazar is listed in the further reading.
t.Casinea: Casinea's neighbours were invited to the Alivetti anniversary, and every business owner there was due to receive Sarcophan consumables after the Solstice, some of which might be illegal in the Empire.
t.Madruga: Madruga's senator, Eulàlia i Phovas i Riqueza, was one of those who could enlist deBruin aid against the Children of Wrecks. Local business owners were also due to receive consumables from the Alivetti festivities.
t.Mareave: Sarcophan entrepreneurs were eager to develop a presence in Beoraidh in western Mareave, while promising not to antagonise the Empire. Delves merchants were supporting a Beoraidh delegation to Anvil.
t.Necropolis: Necropolis was invited to the Alivetti celebrations, and its business owners were due to receive Sarcophan consumables afterwards, possibly including proscribed goods.
t.Sarvos: The Alivetti enclave at Caricomare celebrated five years with a week-long festival, but magistrates struggled to stop smuggling of illegal goods. The Senate weighed extra funding or the Walls of Liberty in response. A magical mask schema was promised to the Mirrored Maschieri if all three invited nations took part.
t.Tassato: Tassato was invited to the Alivetti anniversary, and its business owners were due to receive Sarcophan consumables, some possibly illegal, after the Solstice.

r.Madruga/Free Landing: The deBruin offered 1,500 effective strength for the next attack on the Children of Wrecks at Free Landing before Summer, for 12 Thrones and on condition that the force receives the Imperial guerdon. They would continue each season until it is back in Imperial hands.
r.Mareave/Beoraidh: Partly through Sarcophan influence, representatives of Beoraidh planned to visit Anvil at the Winter Solstice, supported by Delves merchants. Diplomatic matters with the city-state fall to the Imperial Consul.

Apparently with no surprise.d: Bastiaan van Krommemuil's procession for the late Hester van de Moerassen expected to reach the Highguard Chapel on Friday and asked for Whispers through the Black Gate. Unsettling travellers planned to visit the Rod and Shield and the Unfettered Mind. Gelder Kraft and Bramme van Zuredruiven had both arranged to meet Hahnmark farmers at the Tree of Names at the same hour, which risked trouble. Mitwold alders sought defence oaths after the Jotun took Meade. The Spire of the Stallion's Volition sought divinatory exchange with Wintermark. Nicodemus was asked to send Naga to rescue Garev. Highborn herbalists sought a Spring alternative to Ruthless Vigilance, Healthy Crop. Battlefed's envoys sought eternal-powered magic items. Sular's Spyglass agreed to attend Abreya de Lagriffe's inquisition.

n.Grendel: Mentioned in passing: assembly statements honour the Fist of the Mountains for halting a Grendel assault on Urizen, and Urizen vows not to be cowed by the Grendel.
n.Highguard: Several Highborn concerns arose. A Sarcophan funeral was to be hosted at the Highguard Chapel, the Speaker of the Highborn Assembly was asked to send Naga to rescue the mendicant Garev, and Highborn herbalists offered ten thrones towards a new herb-garden ritual.
n.Jotun: Their sudden, overwhelming assault left Mitwold on the brink of falling into Jotun hands, with Meade itself captured.
n.The Marches: Alders of Mitwold travelled to the Community Hall seeking oaths of aid, fearing for the Marches' most valuable territory after the loss of Meade.
n.Urizen: The Spire of the Stallion's Volition, inspired by the Fist of the Mountains' sacrifice at Redoubt, came to meet Urizen seers and illuminates before seeking exchange with Wintermark.
n.Varushka: Boyars received word that the Charnel Lord had sent envoys to the Feast of the Loom in the Varushkan camp, seeking magic items to consume for the benefit of Karsk.
n.Wintermark: Rival Sarcophan merchants sought Hahnmark farmers at the Tree of Names, and Urizen astronomancers hoped to share divinatory methods with stormcrows and mystics after the Fist of the Mountains' sacrifice.

t.Casinea: Strange, off-putting travellers were reported across the territory, and the mendicant Garev lay injured in caves beneath Casfall awaiting rescue.
t.Hahnmark: Farmers growing crops for viezesmaak were sought by both Gelder Kraft and Bramme van Zuredruiven at the same time. Experts warned that a meeting between the rival merchants would go badly for everyone.
t.Karsk: The Charnel Lord sought to reassure Karsk's people, especially those near Broken Barrow, that he remained their protector, promising to turn eternal-powered items into something to benefit them.
t.Mitwold: With the territory teetering on the brink of Jotun control and Meade captured, alders travelled to Anvil to learn of defence plans, especially from the Drakes' general.
t.Ossium: Mentioned in passing: the Charnel Lord disparaged Karsk folk who left for Ossium seeking riches.
t.Redoubt: The Fist of the Mountains' final charge defending Redoubt, witnessed by the Spire of the Stallion's Volition from their homes, inspired the spire's journey to Anvil.
t.Upwold: Mentioned in passing: the Mitwold alders reckoned that even losing Upwold would not be as bad as the Jotun assault on Mitwold.

r.Casinea/Casfall: The injured mendicant Garev was trapped in a treacherous, lightless cave system beneath Casfall, and up to four Naga were sought to reach and treat him without triggering a collapse.

Blood-red blooms.d: The Black Eels, Bone Nautilus and Hamsin, backed by Grendel navies and Asavean mercenaries, seized Mount Siluri and stormed the conjured Keep of Azure Ice. The Imperial armies, aided by Autumn and Summer allies and Spring healing magic, then fell back to Limus. Cathan Canae repelled a Black Eels thrust into Tomari. In Naris, the Sempronia are fortifying Elos, the Tower of Light and Shadow was looted and its Night magic wrecked, and the Pinnacle was sent to Salt Lord Garbhan. Losing Siluri's central heliopticon tower weakens the Doyen of the Spires. Sentinel Gate conjunctions threaten the Academy of Arms, the Brilliant Star and the Abbey of Reconciliation.

n.Dawn: Mentioned in passing: the Black Thorns marched to Redoubt out of Astolat.
n.Druj: Mentioned in passing: the Argent Sword arrived fresh from helping secure victory against the Druj in Zenith.
n.Grendel: The Grendel took Siluri, its mines and the central heliopticon tower, fortified Naris with Asavean help, and looted Urizen libraries and the Pinnacle. Their land armies, especially the Bone Nautilus and Hamsin, were disproportionately weakened in the fighting.
n.Highguard: The newly mustered Pilgrim's Defiance fought alongside the Navarr in Siluri, and the Highborn were enraged to see Grendel bearing looted Wintermark arms. A Grendel mercenary company threatens the Abbey of Reconciliation in Necropolis.
n.Navarr: The Black Thorns, under Cadwell Waystone, marched with the Grey Pilgrims to defend Redoubt and fought in Siluri. Summer goblin warbands joined them, and they withdrew in good order to the hills around Cargo.
n.The League: Mentioned in passing: many of the Winter spirits haunting Naris were raised from League cadavers in Tassato, and the Prelate of Adelmar's Shrine bears a Tassato name.
n.Urizen: Urizen lost Siluri and its central heliopticon tower, and the Tower of Light and Shadow was stripped of its Night magic and its library. Its conjured citadels and the Argent Sword nonetheless helped stop the Grendel taking Tomari and pushing on to Cargo.
n.Wintermark: Grendel warriors carried weapons and shields looted from the Wintermark dead who fell saving Elos. The Pinnacle, a relic of the Fist of the Mountains, was carried off to the Salt Lord of Deinath.

t.Astolat: Mentioned in passing: the Black Thorns set out from Astolat to join the defence of Redoubt.
t.Bay of Catazar: Mentioned in passing: Grendel and Asavean fleets crowd its coast, and seers fear stolen lore could produce a Grendel magical navy able to strike anywhere along the bay.
t.Casinea: Mentioned in passing: the Pilgrim's Defiance had only recently mustered in Casinea before marching to Redoubt.
t.Mareave: Mentioned in passing: the Salt Council's navies and armies are massing in Redoubt and Mareave.
t.Necropolis: A Grendel mercenary company sent by maistir Eilidh is heading through Fishguard to loot the Abbey of Reconciliation, and Abbess Sister Rosa is responsible for stopping it.
t.Redoubt: The Grendel now hold both Siluri and Naris, and Elos is being fortified against recapture. Libraries and spires have been looted, and conjunctions threaten the Academy of Arms and the Brilliant Star.
t.Spiral: Mentioned in passing: the page names only the forges of the Spiral Sword in Limus as a site that would have been threatened had the fighting reached Limus earlier.
t.Tassato: Mentioned in passing: many of the Winter spirits in Naris were raised from League cadavers of Tassato, buried with grave goods the Grendel covet.
t.Therunin: Mentioned in passing: the Black Thorns' general lamented their home in Therunin falling to the sway of the vallorn.
t.Zenith: Mentioned in passing: the Argent Sword came to Redoubt after helping secure victory against the Druj in Zenith.

r.Casinea/Woodwych: Mentioned in passing: the Pilgrim's Defiance's general is Nathaniel of the Woodwych harts.
r.Necropolis/Fishguard: A Grendel mercenary company carrying its pay is travelling through Fishguard towards the Abbey of Reconciliation, intent on looting it.
r.Redoubt/Limus: The Imperial armies retreated into Limus and dug in around Cargo, where the Grendel only harried and probed the north-western hills. A small Grendel embassy in Cargo raises fears of espionage.
r.Redoubt/Naris: Naris stays in Grendel hands. The Sempronia are building makeshift walls around Elos, the Tower of Light and Shadow has been ruined and looted, and the Winter spirits there appear to have been contained by the Grendel.
r.Redoubt/Siluri: The Grendel conquered Siluri, taking Mount Siluri, the Keep of Azure Ice, rich mines and Redoubt's central heliopticon tower. A conjunction also threatens the Academy of Arms with siege and burning.
r.Redoubt/Tomari: The Black Eels' push into Tomari was repelled by the conjured bastion of Cathan Canae and the White Fountain garrison. A conjunction warns of a Grendel raid on the Brilliant Star mithril mine.

Bring you jewels.d: The Golden Pyramid's Grand Lodge was completed in Clisearn, granting prestige that ended the region's uncooperative stance, and closed the order's year of investigations. These produced two proposals: funding an expansion of Savurn Marr's mine in Nadir, creating a Patron of Nadir who could buy cheap ingots and mithril, and the Stallion's Reward sinecure in Clisearn, yielding mana and seasonal vis. Ruicraic's Redoubt now guards Eoradal, but some septs still doubt the Unshackled will stay. Vranitas, herald of the Immovable One, proposed a Tower of the Immovable at the Redoubt. It would grow a settlement over time and give the Strategos 216 rings a season.

n.Grendel: Their attempt to recapture Mareave faltered and was driven back, with Imperial armies holding the upper hand, though Grendel forces remained in Fleisardh. Their mishandling of the former Grendel orcs there helped reconcile some septs to the Unshackled.
n.Imperial Orcs: The Unshackled saw their hold on Mareave strengthened, with the Redoubt garrisoned and local septs warming to them. They were offered a Patron of Nadir title, the Stallion's Reward sinecure and a tower that would fund their Strategos.
n.Urizen: Mentioned in passing: Urizen does not appear in the page; the only link is the name of Ruicraic's Redoubt, a fortification in Mareave.

t.Mareave: The territory prospered as Grendel attacks were repulsed, the aqueduct and Redoubt were completed and the Grand Lodge stood in Clisearn. New opportunities for mines, magical sinecures and a landmark tower were laid out across its regions.
t.Redoubt: Mentioned in passing: the page concerns Ruicraic's Redoubt in Eoradal, Mareave, not the Urizen territory of Redoubt.

r.Mareave/Beoraidh: Mentioned in passing: the independent city-state still prizes its neutrality but is facing the realities of life under Imperial "new management".
r.Mareave/Clisearn: The completed Grand Lodge brought prestige that ended Clisearn's uncooperative stance, and its three major families made informal approaches about trade. The Stallion's Reward sinecure was proposed here to channel the territory's magical flows.
r.Mareave/Eoradal: Ruicraic's Redoubt was completed and garrisoned here, though some septs still doubted the Unshackled would stay. Vranitas proposed the Tower of the Immovable, which would draw a growing settlement around the Redoubt.
r.Mareave/Fleisardh: Mentioned in passing: Grendel armies were still present in Fleisardh and had yet to be dealt with.
r.Mareave/Nadir: Golden Pyramid diviners found a rich new vein, including some mithril, in Savurn Marr's mine. If the Empire funds an expansion, the Imperial Orcs could buy its output cheaply through a Patron of Nadir.

Construct Apstrus Dam.d: Firesong Arachas, the Legion Engineer, commissioned the dam described in the Million miles of water and Damming the Doubt winds of fortune. The work required 30 wains of white granite and the labour of an Imperial army. It also cost 5 thrones to carve the names of the dead into the stones and 5 thrones to relocate the books of Solen's Doubt. The Towerjacks supported the motion after the Winter Solstice. Bloodcrow Rasp supplied the granite, and Raine Tealeaf, Halkyon of the Myriad Stream, Callista and Rhys Nighthaven contributed money. Once complete, the dam made Icarion an oasis and raised the territory's taxation by 6 thrones a season.

n.Grendel: Grendel held Mareave during this season, so it was among the holders of the territory whose region of Icarion received the dam's diverted water.
n.Imperial Orcs: For the Imperial Orcs, who held Mareave, the dam turned Icarion into an oasis and increased the taxation the territory produces by 6 thrones a season.
n.The League: The dam was built on League-held land in Apstrus, Spiral, and the books of Solen's Doubt had to be relocated as part of the work.

t.Mareave: Mareave received the diverted water in Icarion, which became an oasis, and the territory's taxation rose by 6 thrones a season.
t.Spiral: Spiral became the site of the new dam in Apstrus, built from 30 wains of white granite with the names of the dead carved into its stones.

r.Mareave/Icarion: Water redirected from Apstrus transformed Icarion into an oasis.
r.Spiral/Apstrus: The dam was raised in Apstrus by the labour of an Imperial army, and the books of Solen's Doubt were moved to make way for it.

Construct Beacon of Sermersuaq.d: Proposed by the senator for Sermersuaq and seconded by Madruga, the motion commissioned the last of the Beacons of Wintermark. It invoked a boon granted by Cathan Canae in recognition of Wintermark's resilience against two armies of Oblivion. The work cost 30 wains of white granite, 25 wains of weirwood and 165 crowns in labour, and took six months. Garth supplied nearly all the materials, while Otmar van Holberg, Fedelmidd Sydanjaa's Heart Floer and several others contributed money. Once completed, military units could guard the beacons, and Cathan Canae undertook to send the ritual text of Drums of the Iron Harpoon to the General of the Narwhal's Spear at the Summer Solstice 388YE.

n.Wintermark: Wintermark completed the final set of its Beacons, with the work commissioned in recognition of its resilience against two armies of Oblivion. The General of the Narwhal's Spear was to receive the ritual text of Drums of the Iron Harpoon from Cathan Canae.

t.Sermersuaq: Sermersuaq gained the Beacons of Sermersuaq, which military units were able to guard once construction was complete.

r.Sermersuaq/Sealtoq: The beacons were raised in Sealtoq, built from white granite and weirwood over six months.

Construct Black Obelisk.d: Proposed by Casinea and seconded by Zenith, the motion commissioned an edifice called "The Black Obelisk" in Stockmarch, Upwold, describing it as fully self-funded. It would commemorate the herald Obligatus and Geraint Black, a landskeeper, leader of the Unbound Union and Keeper of the Prosperity of Afal, in the wake of cultist activity in the territory. The construction required standard costs plus 10 wains of white granite and 30 crowns in labour, and would take three months to complete. After the Winter Solstice, Edgar Guildenstern provided the 10 wains of white granite and Ehud provided 3 thrones 6 crowns. The page records no outcome for the completed work.

n.The Marches: The Marches would gain a memorial in its own lands to the Marcher landskeeper Geraint Black, leader of the Unbound Union, and to the herald Obligatus, marking the losses caused by cultists in Upwold.

t.Upwold: The Black Obelisk was commissioned for the Guildenstern estate in Stockmarch, Upwold, in response to cultist activity there, and Edgar Guildenstern supplied the white granite for its construction.

Construct Circo del Topo.d: The commission required 10 wains of weirwood and 30 crowns in labour costs and took three months to complete. The resulting sinecure provides an income of 216 rings per season and is supervised by the Temeschwari Topolino. This Imperial title is appointed by unanimous decision of the League senators and is held with tenure until death, resignation or revocation. The holder works with the Temeschwar Rat Catchers guild to find wider business uses for captured rats, beginning with training them for entertainment. The project was organised by Red Raven Holdings. Giacomo Corvinoscuro provided 3 thrones 6 crowns and the weirwood after the Winter Solstice 387YE.

n.The League: The League gains a new tenured Imperial title, the Temeschwari Topolino, which its senators appoint by unanimous decision and which carries an income of 216 rings per season.

t.Temeschwar: Temeschwar gains the Circo del Topo, which ties its Rat Catchers guild to new business ventures, starting with rats trained for entertainment.

r.Temeschwar/Hanuri: The Circo del Topo was built in Hanuri and completed after the Winter Solstice 387YE.

Construct Gardens of the Perfect World.d: Proposed by the senator for Sarangrave and seconded by the Conscience of the Senate, the self-funded motion had the approval of the Urizen National Assembly and arose from the Poets light but lamps wind of fortune. Construction required 15 wains of weirwood and 45 crowns in labour costs and took three months. After the Winter Solstice, Abel the Rounder of Sarangrave Reforged provided the weirwood and 5 thrones 2 crowns, with a crown each from Farren Silver Streams, Serenus Starsong and Rhys Nighthaven. Once complete, the Urizen Assembly could appoint the Seeker of the Perfect World for the first time at the Spring Equinox 388YE, opening the way to further trade with Tsark.

n.Urizen: Urizen gains a new ministry whose holder, the Seeker of the Perfect World, is appointed by the Urizen Assembly from Spring Equinox 388YE, giving the nation a channel for trade with Tsark.

t.Zenith: Zenith becomes home to the Gardens of the Perfect World, a ministry for trading weirwood and liao with Tsark for white granite.

r.Zenith/Occursion: The Gardens of the Perfect World were built in Occursion over three months following the Winter Solstice 387YE.

Construct Haros Riverpatrol.d: The motion was proposed by the senator for Necropolis and seconded by Mournwold, and it passed. The commission cost 15 wains of weirwood and 45 crowns in labour, and would take three months to complete. After the Winter Solstice 387YE, money was donated by Kish of the Flame Beneath the Earth, Triska Markova, Farren Silver Streams, Rhys Nighthaven and others. Caleb of the Cenotaph supplied the 15 wains of weirwood after the Autumn Equinox 388YE, when Kish gave a further throne and seven crowns. Once complete, the sinecure creates the Coursguard title, appointed by a Tally of the Votes of the owners of Highborn congregations.

n.Highguard: Highborn congregation owners will choose the Coursguard by Tally of the Votes once the sinecure is complete, giving Highguard's faithful a new appointed position in Reikos.

t.Reikos: The commission placed a new Imperial sinecure, the Haros Riverpatrol, in Highguard-held Reikos, and private donors funded and supplied its construction.

r.Reikos/Haros Water: Haros Water is the site of the Haros Riverpatrol, built with 15 wains of weirwood and 45 crowns of labour over three months.

Construct Monument to Silent Bell.d: As Mistress of Monuments, Ada Droon proposed the monument and stated that Anatolij Paukov Zorkin would fully fund it. Standard costs applied: 6 wains of white granite, 18 crowns in labour, and three months to complete. After the Winter Solstice 387YE, Zorkin provided 2 thrones 2 crowns and the 6 wains of white granite. The page records no outcome, so it does not confirm whether the pillar was finished.

n.Highguard: The pillar honouring the Silent Bell sodality was to stand in Reikos, a territory Highguard held at the time, adding a monument to the Way within Highguard's lands.

t.Reikos: Reikos was chosen as the site of a white granite pillar celebrating the Silent Bell sodality, with materials and funds supplied by Anatolij Paukov Zorkin.

r.Reikos/Broken Ride: Broken Ride was the intended location of the engraved white granite pillar, which was expected to take three months to build once paid for.

Construct Municipal Docks.d: Proposed by Madruga's senator and seconded by Hahnmark, the motion arose from the Germinating a city wind of fortune. The commission cost 80 wains of white granite, 40 wains of weirwood and 45 thrones in labour, with 5 thrones a season upkeep, all provided by Gisli i Phovas i Guerra after the Winter Solstice. Once complete, the docks boost Madruga's taxation by 12 thrones a season, fortify Calvos Sound, serve as a shipyard for up to two navies, and create the Freeborn title Quaymaster of the Municipal Docks. From Autumn 388YE they also raise investment in Madruga's fleets and businesses, raise Freeborn incomes, cheapen fleet upgrades and open a new kraken-hunting voyage.

n.The Brass Coast: The Freeborn gain the new Quaymaster title, a year of increased income and cheaper fleet upgrades, greater investment in Madruga's fleets and businesses, and a new questing voyage to hunt the Free Landing Kraken.

t.Madruga: Madruga gains a great work that boosts its taxation by 12 thrones a season, houses a shipyard for up to two navies and draws greater investment to its fleets and businesses.

r.Madruga/Calvos Sound: The Municipal Docks are built in Calvos Sound, which becomes protected as a level one fortification and home to a shipyard for up to two navies.
r.Madruga/Free Landing: Mentioned in passing: the docks open a new Freeborn questing voyage named Hunt the Free Landing Kraken.

Construct Office of Fire and Stone.d: The construction was announced under an Imperial Wayleave rather than voted on by the Senate, and its costs followed the opportunity described in the wind of fortune The thing with feathers. The edifice required 20 wains of mithril, 10 wains of white granite, 10 rings of ilium and 90 crowns in labour, and took three months to complete. After the Winter Solstice, Edmundo supplied all of the materials and 11 thrones, while Farren Silver Streams and Rhys Nighthaven each gave a crown. Once it was complete, the Architect of Hammers could be appointed for the first time at the Spring Equinox 388YE, for a shortened term ending at the Autumn Equinox 388YE.

n.Urizen: Urizen gained a new national position, the Architect of Hammers, appointed by a Tally of the Votes of Urizen owners of mana sites, with the first appointment due at the Spring Equinox 388YE.

t.Zenith: Zenith, held by Urizen, gained the Office of Fire and Stone, a completed edifice built of mithril, white granite and ilium.

r.Zenith/Iteri: The Office of Fire and Stone was built in Iteri and completed there after the Winter Solstice 387YE, largely at Edmundo of Damakan's Forge's own expense.

Construct Ozren Orzel Inspirational Tomb.d: The motion commissioned a great work honouring the exemplar of Pride Ozren Orzel in Sandling, as set out in the 'An eagle in song' Wind of Fortune. It cost 30 wains of white granite and 90 crowns in labour, and would take three months to complete. After the Winter Solstice, Starac Sijed Orzel provided 9 thrones 4 crowns and all 30 wains of granite. Smaller sums came from Ser Geoffrey de Lorilam, Farren Silver Streams, Rhys Nighthaven, Ser Gareth Haywain, Lady Nineve Orzel and Konstantin Rabovich Bolotnikov. Once complete, congregations in Weirwater would receive a Philtre of Strength each season. The eighty-one individuals named by Tarik, former High Bard of the Empire, would receive some reward from the Witches of Culwich.

n.Dawn: Two Dawnish senators, those of Weirwater and Astolat, proposed and seconded the motion, and the finished tomb would give congregations in Dawn's territory of Weirwater a Philtre of Strength each season.
